column3: AN ACT TO AMEND THE NATIONAL MINIMUM WAGE OF WORKERS

column2: BE it  enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

column3: This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  National  Minimum

column2: Wage of Workers (Amendment) Act, No.       of  2021.

column3: Section 3 of the National Minimum Wage of Workers

column2: Act, No. 3 of 2016 is hereby amended in subsection (1) thereof
by  the  substitution  for  the  words,  “shall  be  ten  thousand
rupees and the national minimum daily wage of a worker
shall be four hundred rupees” of the words, “shall be twelve
thousand  five  hundred  rupees  and  the  national  minimum
daily wage of a worker shall be five hundred rupees.”.

column3: In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala

column2: and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
